> [This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations.](embed:https://example.com)

The webpage at [Example Domain](embed:https://example.com) is a reserved placeholder managed by [IANA](wiki:Internet_Assigned_Numbers_Authority) (Internet Assigned Numbers Authority) specifically for use in illustrative examples, documentation, and tutorials. It allows authors and developers to reference a standard URL without needing prior permission or coordination. 

The site advises readers to avoid using this domain in actual live operations or production systems. You can read more about its intended purpose on the [IANA Example Domains page](https://iana.org/domains/example).

***
